notes.title: To the Clouds!
notes.content:
[h1]Cloud Walking[/h1]
Sky Island, the largest expansion for  Rise of the Pirates is now live. The new islands bring pirates and marines closer to the end-game goals, with challenges and achievements that will unlock as players complete quests and defeat bosses. In this post we'll cover everything you need to know about Sky Island's arrival as well as how it impacts your character now that it has begun rolling out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/09d259db92e12037eb19f0ff36c1db9dc4ec1155.png[/img]


[h2]Sky Island expansion includes a new islands full of wonders[/h2]
Sky Island is an area that players can explore and earn rewards for doing so. The island itself takes place in the sky above the seas surrounding Sky City where players will find many challenges as they complete quests and defeat bosses while attempting to Uncover its secrets.

These  islands bring pirates and marines closer to the end-game goal. You can't just go there and start farming it; you have to build a ship and navigate the Black Sea after completing your training. The enemies on the new island are different from other areas in the game, which means that you'll need to adjust your strategy accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/1eecbe80719aa7e338fa60df3a3e67fbc43b3cb0.png[/img]

This Update begins the expansion of the Black Sea overworld. Where we will be adding islands to explore beyond Sakura, Krakeia Island and Ghrungish Swamp Island. 
Before achieving flight players crash land in Aya Island, a large island with a variety of enemies and quests filled with those who have given up on the dreams of reaching as high as the sky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/1384f344f99770f249e3a683f6d5c3a3ec166b9e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/85926380f64dce7c41191d05a964f19ef250f4d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/4b827c4df69aebb6d71f56faa660ae277f58587a.png[/img]

The Sky Island is a mysterious place, where you will find islands to explore and complete puzzles. The primary goal of this update is to add more content to the game with boss fights and island exploration and PVE Features.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/34baf640a3d6e5cb8a7f98b1b9e262fd78ed514d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/bd01c104b05326e4c36723621086978e3e92f9de.png[/img]
[h1]Sky Relic System[/h1]
The Relic system is a way for players to get passive abilities and powers by finding  Sky Shards. This is going to be a great addition to the game, as it will add a lot more depth and strategic options for players.  Leveling up your Relic will provide you with new abilities and passive bonuses that can be used to help you in battle. The higher you level it up, the more powerful these abilities will become. I can't wait to see what strategies players come up with using the Relic system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/717ecb323fd53171bf99805e69d7fa0823c3d6eb.png[/img]

[h2]The challenges bring a Higher Level cap.[/h2]
This level cap is a huge deal for the game and it's something that I've been looking forward to for a long time. It's a great way to keep players engaged and it gives us something to strive for. I know that some people might be worried about the grind involved in reaching the level cap but I think it's definitely worth it. This step opens doors for new skills and possibly. Stronger Gear as we continue to roll out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/8d6931a7c5b389dea651c25af211afa898ad63cf.png[/img]
[h2]'Hero' Race: Seraph[/h2]


The addition of a new playable race, the Seraph!  To unlock the Seraph, you’ll need to complete the Sky Island storyline. Doing so will give you access to all of the Seraph’s unique abilities, including the ability to fly!  The Seraph are a proud race of warriors who have sworn to protect the innocent. They are incredibly powerful and make for a great addition to any party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/4d5db3c77f28e85be2ec44ff1ff0d5987b62f0c3.png[/img]



[h2]Minor Features.[/h2]

[h3]Mini Bars[/h3]
This update is packed with new features and content that will sure to please everyone. For starters, we have the Party UI Bars which make it easier to see and manage your party's status. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/18eaa94cf8ecb95f1d110eb5cd9a3f6049b22af2.png[/img]

[h3]Bank Search[/h3]
We also have a  Search feature for player banks, which makes finding what you're looking for a breeze.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/ce6bc8b6a62dcd2e2d472a7ca61067dedffa7ee6.png[/img]
[h3]Renaming Bank Slots[/h3]
We now have the ability to rename player bank slots, so you can keep your inventory tidy and organized just the way you like it. Keep your rum in your Rum bank slot!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/9d3726b86fa5d324f7c01d9430553c9eec746ea9.png[/img]

[h3]Equipment Ranking Up![/h3]
The Rank Up feature allows you to select a stat to increase on a piece of equipment. To begin ranking an item, you must right-click it and select "rank up." This will prompt you to select a focus. This process can only be done once and costs 100,000 escudo. To rank up a gear piece after selecting a focus, you need 100,000 escudo and an item of the same name and rarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/d2c64d81da3ea184782f8e8781770727809db247.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/4b9bfb855f972e6819c4bdc5ec39fdb316508ffe.png[/img]
[h3]New Grass Tileset![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/bd217537e9657eb2cfa768043b8b3fb2d054e919.png[/img]
[h3]Grappling Hook System[/h3]
I’m super excited introducing a grappling hook system that will make traversing the world map much more fun and strategic.  Here’s a quick rundown of what’s currently possible with this system and some ideas we have for the future.

 -A grappling hook system that will let you zip around the world map

  - obstacles on the world map that can only be traversed with the grappling hook

  - More treasure chests hidden around the world map 

 -A boss battle that can only be accessed with the grappling hook  I think this update is going to be a blast and I can’t wait to start using the grappling hook to zip around the world map! The obstacles are going to be a great challenge and the added treasure chests are going to be a nice reward for those who take the time to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/a57d26f554184ea1a7bb05d21ccb3aaac9f13114.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/1ce70a900c56c73a1a6217db52e4be8c3dbbeaa4.gif[/img]

The Rise of the Pirates team is hard at work on many new features for the game, including more bosses to fight, new islands to explore and a Sky Tower. We will be adding them soon so stay tuned! If you want to get involved with the development process then make sure you check out the [url=https://discord.gg/4ryzSCURcw]Discord[/url]! where we have details about how we plan updates and what players can expect next!

notes.title: A Master Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/c119377d806f522cb932a205a2286693cd61aa21.png[/img]
[h1]A Master Update![/h1]
[h2]Class Mastery System. [/h2]
The longer you stay with a class and the more you use it the better you become with it. 
We want to reflect this with a new feature. You can now gain levels for your class by simply using it. Fighting enemies near your level of power and of course PvP action. This feature is account based not character based so if you enjoy playing another class they or the same class across different characters no need to worry. Play any character and your progress will affect all your characters. Now leveling the class mastery will not give you any edge but we would like to reward you with some perks. So we also like to introduce in this update the new Class Skin feature!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/7a3e66989a6674a5ae75fc9e94cd83aaccba1e32.png[/img]

[h2]Class Skins[/h2]
Just like the Class Mastery is account based so is the class skin system. So no need to worry on unlocking the same skin on all characters it is shared. Class skins change the appearance of some if not all your classes skills. Currently we have over 40 classes and intend to have beautiful options for every class! However it will take some time. We are going to be rolling out new skins every week. Keep and eye out for your class! Skins can be unlocked by reaching a certain level with your class mastery for that specific class.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/149dc623a0a2d0d0c59e9b3dac1fb207249cdb08.png[/img]
Rose Petals and Green Gale skins for Air!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/17392f6eab456761d632a6b5bd60d68627660a8b.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/dbf6263984de993374a1e91792127e4585a4060b.gif[/img]

Currently these classes have skins at this time. More to come every week.
Smoke
Air
Blood
Light


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/83dd9c1bfe47a58533c0bb1dc78c3e634ef3ecad.png[/img]
[h2]Tweaks and Bug Fixes[/h2]
Gunslinger's default attack now stops at the first enemy hit. Can still hit multiple objects obstructing the bullet.
While in combat(PVP) all healing overtime effects are reduced by 25%.
increased size of earth cage.
Knifey event cooldown lowered to 2.5 mins down from 5.5 minutes.
 
[h2]New Server![/h2]
For those who enjoy starting a new adventure or get intimidated by how far ahead everyone else is we introduce a new server as an option. The Phoenix server. This server has increased drop rates and exp rates. So you can catch up faster in both gear and levels. However this server will reset every 4 months allowing everyone to begin again from square one. If this is something you enjoy burn bright and rise from the ashes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/959f54a5b2fec51ea48a97ab21348dcf9d74be0f.png[/img]

notes.title: First Update Of the New Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/c119377d806f522cb932a205a2286693cd61aa21.png[/img]

[b]Hope everyone had a great holiday season! Lets start 2020 off with some updates![/b]

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[h2]Black Sea Island Conquering [/h2]
You can now fight over and conquer the islands in Black Sea providing amazing buffs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/df97edf74296d5aaab8c8af00cd201b4d4e4639a.png[/img]

[b]How to conquer:[/b] You will first need to find the islands flag and stake your claim.
If there is anyone else attempting to claim the island you will need to dispatch them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/22c9d77196cb07245b52534acda0d51e0e8ca150.gif[/img]
Once you have claimed the island you and your crew or fleet receive the buffs from said island while you are on that island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/40b1287d108846fb7a0f257cf0c61b27d7d4584b.png[/img]

Please let us know if you have any suggestions on the buffs. We read every suggestion.

Boss Enemies in Black Sea have a chance to drop void and diamond drills.
Boss Enemies = Any Enemy in Black Sea that is not a Rotz Pawn.

[h2]Ambition[/h2]
Completing all daily challenges now provides players with a Rested Buff increasing all ambition gains by 25%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/a82d0a9ba7d744fdb4b5b598ff6186793c516d78.png[/img]

All Weight Training tweaked. Takes slightly longer between reps to get exp.
Once Level 2500 Ambition is reached Weight Training ambition gains reduced by 50%.

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
New Seasonal Food: New Years Cake
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/736cdf39145320cd85c42a6e429f284ba0d76bc2.png[/img]

Heirloom chest now have a 90% chance at a wisdom stone and a 5% chance at a box of wisdom stones per open.

Legendary drop rate increased slightly across all servers

Siren notes can now be popped in 1 hit.

Efficiency changes to the way UI HP,End,Fat and exp bars work.


[h2]Barber[/h2]
5 new hairstyles at the barber! Thank you Blany Thank you Kardon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34343261/b13c22f6abd3ac91227072c5813a231ebcd2b55b.gif[/img]

notes.title: Seasons Rise
notes.content:
[h1]Legendary Item Changes[/h1]
Tweaks to legendary equipment stats and drop rate. They should be slightly easier to find.

[h1]Hidden Treasure Changes[/h1]
X Marks the spot event will now let you know when the treasure vanishes.
[h1]
Exp Changes[/h1]
Exp from monsters cut off point has been tweaked,
Previously Enemies 30 levels below you would no longer provide you with any EXP.  Now everything will always give you exp, however if you are too high a level they will give you reduced exp.
New formula if your level is 15% + 30 higher than the enemy they will no longer give 100% exp.
So an enemy level 100 will give you full exp until you are level 145.
A level 300 enemy will give full exp until lv 375 etc.

[h1]Ambition Changes[/h1]
Weight Training now increases ambition 2% per minute.
The EXP changes above also means you can train ambition by hunting lower level enemies.

[h1]Season System[/h1]
World Season: Seasonal rewards will be rewarded depending on achievements and season level reached during the season. 

Season Level: All enemies no matter what level will provide season exp. So if you wan’t to go on a rampage in a lower level area feel free to do so. However we do recommend going after daily bosses and finding hidden treasure for the best results.

Season Rewards: Players will automatically receive season rewards once they reach the goal. Rewards can be found in the Season Menu

End season rewards will be posted nearing the end of the season. ~3 months per season.

notes.title: Recovered from burn out. Let's get back to the marathon, no more sprinting.
notes.content:
[h1]If you’re going to burn, burn bright.[/h1]
Updates will resume on a bi-weekly basis.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
NPC vanguard treasure hunting tweaks.

Item Level cap raised to 600 (Steam server) 900 byond server.
What this means? Boss mobs will be dropping better gear with better stats.

Rare Items buffed

[h1]Music and Sound Effects[/h1]
Music and sound effects are being added.

To preview them under open sound settings under options. 

Basic sounds have been completed. Combat/Class specific sounds will be completed accordingly. Feed back is appreciated. So let us know if something does not sound right. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34343261/05b0202b20d224d1beaa1a19b4a7a60d3373152c.png[/img]



[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
Quest descriptions are now less verbose. 

On Screen text is easier to notice and read.

Lower level mobs are now harder to fight however provide more exp.


Event Reward Bags now provide valor points instead of cursed gear. 


Shovel Luck variable increased. (Luck increases chance of  finding a treasure chest/hitting the bottom and knowing the treasure is not there.)


Treasure Chest Rewards now also drop crafting materials.

On Screen Text is more readable.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
UI Toggle: Players can now toggle the UI to capture better screenshots/videos.


Quest Scrolls are a bit more forgiving


[b]Gear Scrapper:[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34343261/940506a86109cc2d3183edd180041e77537df945.png[/img]Destroy equipment and salvage some materials. This machine can be found in all major cities including the Black sea islands. Scrapping high level Elites will provide players with a rare crafting material used to craft epic gear.



[b]X Marks the Spot: [/b]A new world event where an X will spawns on a map and must be dug up to collect. First to dig it up gets the treasure.


[b]Event Bot:[/b] The game will now let discord know when an event is going on if enough players are online to start it. [url=https://discord.gg/dJ6sDsb]Join Rise of the Pirates Discord Here[/url]


[h1]The Hiatus:[/h1]After we released the game on steam I began to work to address any and all issues that came up. Many of our not so common gaming conventions we were accustomed to on byond for instance. Coupled with that scrambling, content and expansion along with work related  stress I learned that I was not immune to burn out. I took some time to recover. I have stopped trying to sprint the marathon. Let’s get back to work but before that allow me to thank the people who helped me through this. Kurai, Bjisboss, Minato, Hinokage, Blaze and Cotton. You all warned me to take things slow, I did not listen. Then instead of I told you so, You all told me it was okay to take my time this allowed me to feel less guilty about the time I was taking to recover. Thank you.

notes.title: Update: WSAD and Key Binds
notes.content:
[h1]WSAD & Key Binds[/h1]

[b]WSAD Movement[/b]
Many players have expressed the desire for WSAD movement. This is the industry standard. We should have done this sooner! Thank you for the feedback! This is now the default.

[b]New Key bind System.[/b]

We did not stop there!  You can now bind any key to any action. Change your movement controls and other commands at will. 

Under the controls in your top bar you will find "Open Controls Menu" This will open the menu. From here just click the action you would like to bind to a key and then when prompted press the key you will bind it to.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34343261/c5e8444ad2aa2c10a366865531e2cd15390d9249.png[/img]

We also noticed how this would inhibit many of you pro Macro-ers. So under Options top bar menu you will find a Custom Macro option. Here you may bind any unique command to any key. You can view your custom macros by pressing View Custom Macros.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34343261/58043902c989bf01ac7bdecd100cc4d9606fd8aa.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes/Changes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Dagon
[list]
[*]Dagons was only getting higher endurance regeneration while in water. They will now also get better health regeneration while in water.
[*]Eel Trait now lasts 7 seconds.
[/list]

    [*]Treasure Maps no longer have a delay to open.
    [*]Fixed Issues with Shark Mount.
 [*]Rotz Spy has returned to Anchor Island.
 [*]PVM Event now heals you to full when you enter.
 [*]Visual Update: New Tress and Houses.
[/list]
